sections.content: Now N still present. Likely need to click all N cells, but batch stops early when a click has no impact (maybe after they are gone). Need to click until none left. Let's click remaining N cells one by one until no N left. We'll loop: while N exists, click first.

sections.label: TOOL CALL: python
sections.content:
<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
while True:
    # find any N
    coords=[]
    for r,line in enumerate(current_frame.ascii.split('\n')):
        for c,ch in enumerate(line):
            if ch=='N':
                coords.append((r,c))
    if not coords:
        break
    # click first
    action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':coords[0][0],'col':coords[0][1]}])
    # after action, break if no impact? continue loop
    if last_action_result.get('no_impact'):
        break
print('done')
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
